meta.title: Choose an existing event to test Edit Evaluation Time
gaps: Record the selected event title and RFX number in Test Data.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Record the selected event title and RFX number in Test Data.

steps.note: Open the Events list where event state and searchable cards can be inspected.
Confirm the Events list rendered successfully with its Create Event control and no error.
Evaluation-time events are expected among the currently live events.
Open the first existing event whose card explicitly shows the required evaluation state.
Confirm the opened event still shows the expected evaluation-time status.
Confirm the selected event has at least one vendor response/bid.
